name: jev-model-router
description: Picks the model and the reasoning effort for each task with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached either through TypeSafe's own API or the Vercel AI Gateway. Routes subagent models at agent.spawn and the main loop's effort and model at turn.step, in both directions, falling back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; preferred over the Gateway, since only it reports a calibrated confidence

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway; with none set the engine's built-in classifier is used instead

provider.title: Backend
provider.description: Which backend to use; "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then the Gateway, then the built-in classifier

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model
typesafeModel.description: Decision model on TypeSafe's own API; empty uses jev-latest

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway; empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai

gatewayModel.title: AI Gateway model
gatewayModel.description: Decision model on the AI Gateway; empty uses typesafe-ai/jev

fastModel.title: Fast tier
fastModel.description: Model alias or id for mechanical, local tasks

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier
balancedModel.description: Model alias or id for ordinary engineering work

deepModel.title: Deep tier
deepModel.description: Model alias or id for hard or high-stakes work

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend more
minUpgradeConfidence.description: How sure the decision must be to raise the model or the effort; being wrong here costs money, so the bar is low

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend less
minDowngradeConfidence.description: How sure it must be to lower the model or the effort; being wrong here means a task gets too little, so the bar is high

routeSubagentModel.title: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Pick the model of each subagent at agent.spawn (the Agent tool takes no effort)

routeMainEffort.title: Route the main loop's effort
routeMainEffort.description: Raise or lower the reasoning effort of the main conversation

routeMainModel.title: Route the main loop's model
routeMainModel.description: Change the model of the main conversation; off by default because switching models mid-session invalidates the prompt cache

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a decision before letting the request through unchanged

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each routing decision to the session log

taskRoutingMode.title: Task routing mode
taskRoutingMode.description: Basic uses fast/balanced/deep routing. Custom uses our task preferences with Basic fallback. Observe keeps Basic routing active and only logs what Custom would pick. All respect routing switches. Edit hooks/task-routing.ts for rules/examples and catalog/models.json for model capabilities; then run node scripts/build-catalog.mjs.

taskMinConfidence.title: Task classification confidence
taskMinConfidence.description: Minimum confidence for applying a task-role preference

orchestrationModel.title: orchestrationModel
orchestrationModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

visualAnalysisModel.title: visualAnalysisModel
visualAnalysisModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

designLedModel.title: designLedModel
designLedModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

mechanicalModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

fileScoutModel.title: fileScoutModel
fileScoutModel.description: Preferred catalog model ID for this role or implementation category

classifyTurns.title: Per-turn classification and logging
classifyTurns.description: Classify main prompts and log recommendations even when main model and effort routing are disabled
